gap_details.2011-2012: Wayback 2012-09-21 capture of main.uab.edu/Sites/neurosurgery/education/40944/ is content-dated 2011-12 (PGY-1 Dawkins/Foreman/Romeo = 2011 entrants; 2012 graduates Fleming/Naftel still chiefs). Chief-resident PGYs set from the May-2011 page (Fleming PGY-6, Naftel PGY-5 in 2010-11).
gap_details.2012-2013: No 2012-13 roster anywhere: Wayback captures of 40944 have only 2 digests (2011-05, 2012-09), Common Crawl CC-MAIN-2013-20 copy (2013-05-19) is byte-identical to the 2011-12 list; division home/education/overview pages Oct-2012..Apr-2013 carry no names; uabneurosurgery.com starts 2013-05 with first roster capture 2013-09. Reconstructed 16 (13 bracketed; 3 alumni-2013 graduates Fusco/Whisenhunt/Mortazavi; 2012 entrants Amburgy/McClugage/Dupepe from 2013-14 PGY-2 + alumni). An intern or resident who left during 2012-13 would be invisible. Phase 2: re-checked all Sept-2012 education subpages (40942-87442: overview, visiting students, courses, clinical research staff, Galbraith prizes naming only Gordon/Fusco/Miller) and Wayback host audit 2012-05..2013-10 (main.uab.edu/Sites/neurosurgery, /Sites/surgery, /Sites/gme, uabneurosurgery.com): no roster. PubMed 2012-14 UAB-neurosurgery affiliations show no unlisted resident. Every 2011-12 resident not graduating in 2012-13 reappears in 2013-14, so the only invisible case is a 4th 2012 intern who left within the year: low significance.
gap_details.2016-2017: Only 2 PGY-1s (Salehani, Tabibian). Phase 2: Common Crawl CC-MAIN-2016-30 copy of education/current-residents dated 2016-07-24 already shows the new 2016-17 roster with the same 2 PGY-1s (June-2016 and 2016-07-01 copies still show 2015-16). Program total in 2016-17 = 21 = 7x3 ACGME complement because the 2013 class had 4; a third 2016 intern would have made 22. Conclusion: unfilled (complement-offset) slot, not an unseen early leaver.
gap_details.2017-2018: No Wayback capture of the new education/residency/current-residents URL before 2019-11; old URL stale (Aug/Sept/Nov-2017 = 2016-17 list). Used Common Crawl CC-MAIN-2018-09 copy (2018-02-19, UIkit filter tags 'PGY n'); May/Aug-2018 CC copies identical.
gap_details.2018-2019: Common Crawl CC-MAIN-2018-43 copy (2018-10-22); Jan-2019 CC copy identical.
gap_details.2020-2021: Only capture is 2021-04-14 (spring) but content is 2020-21 (PGY-1 = 2020 entrants).

departures.name: Logan Powell
departures.note: PGY-1 on 2025-26 roster (Aug-2025, Jan-2026); absent from live 2026-27 roster, PGY-2 class shows only Butler and Patrick. Left after PGY-1; destination unknown. The adjudicator's NPI 'switched specialty' call is not evidence; training_history row recorded with departure_type='unknown'.

problems: John Amburgy (2012 entrant) is listed PGY-7 on four consecutive rosters (2018-19..2021-22) while the alumni page gives graduation 2021; entry-year inconsistency left as listed (probable extended/research time or stale listing). E.B. Kuhn = Elizabeth Alford (married name, rosters 2014-2019 as Kuhn, 2020-21 as Alford, alumni 2021 as Alford); canonicalised to 'Elizabeth Alford'. Pre-2013 classes had irregular PGY labels (e.g. Gordon PGY-3 2010-11 -> PGY-4 2011-12 -> chief 2013-14, graduated 2014; Griessenauer PGY-2 -> PGY-4); 2013-14 chief Gordon set to PGY-6 from her 2011-12 PGY-4. John Amburgy: alumni page grad 2021 while still listed PGY-7 on the Dec-2021 roster, probably an off-cycle (late-2021) finish after extra time; counted as completed. No Common Crawl failures.

2016-2017.reason: 2016 class of 2 confirmed by CC copy 2016-07-24 (~3 weeks into the year) and 21 residents = 7x3 complement; the 2013 class of 4 used the third 2016 slot. Unfilled slot, not an unseen leaver.

2012-2013.reason: All 13 continuing residents appear on both 2011-12 and 2013-14 rosters; 3 graduates on alumni page (2013); 2012 class = 3 (full complement) seen at PGY-2 in 2013-14 and all graduated. Only a 2012 intern above complement who left before Sept 2013 could be unseen; no such person in site pages (all Sept-2012 education subpages checked) or PubMed 2012-14 UAB neurosurgery affiliations.
